transport: POST /api/browser-agent with Authorization: Bearer <token from the Connect Codex descriptor>; every request also carries "connection": <descriptor.connection>. Errors are HTTP 409 {"error": code}. Every call runs in one transaction after the revocation check, so any 409 (connection_unavailable included) means nothing was applied.
notes: limits are the effective limits, all checked before anything is written: text in Unicode code points, ids in UTF-16 code units, the whole body in bytes. ask_post bounds "Question: <question>\nDefault: <default>" plus "\nOptions: " and the options joined by " / " when options are given, for every ask whatever its placement. summary already allows for the "Done by <agent>, waiting for the owner to confirm: " prefix. id_pattern: next_task never offers a task whose id fails it. title, next_action and notes bound create_task and update_task.
